title: Private Guided Old Montréal and Downtown Walking Tour
blurb:
Explore the vibrant heart of Montréal with our exclusive private walking tour, designed to immerse you in the rich tapestry of downtown and Old Montréal. Embark on a captivating journey through iconic landmarks, including the scenic Dorchester Square, the bustling Sainte-Catherine Street, the fascinating RÉSO (Underground Pedestrian Network), the architecturally stunning Palais des congrès, the dynamic World Trade Centre, the charming Victoria Square, the historic Saint-Paul Street, the picturesque Cours le Royer, and the enchanting squares of Place d'Armes and Place Royale.

Let our knowledgeable guides unveil the city's hidden gems, share captivating stories, and provide insider insights as you stroll through the streets of Montréal.
